AND a.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

mapper.update: UPDATE swm_helmet_device SET assigned_person = NULL, person_name = NULL, person_phone = NULL, assigned_workshop = NULL, assigned_process = NULL, assigned_team = NULL, unbind_time = NOW(), usage_status = 0, update_date = NOW() WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND status = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.device_id, a.helmet_type, a.battery_level, a.ip, a.mac_address, a.assigned_person, sp.name as personName, sp.phone_number as personPhone, fpa.position_name AS assigned_workshop, wg.work_group_name as assigned_team, a.motion_status, a.bind_time, a.unbind_time, a.bind_duration_days, a.usage_status, a.server_ip, a.server_port, a.bluetooth_scan_window, a.group_duration, a.normal_beacon_cs, a.special_beacon_cs, a.location_mode, a.deep_sleep_duration, a.bluetooth_scan_duration, a.send_interval, a.hazard_retrigger_interval, a.sleep_wakeup_time, a.beacon_filter_name, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks FROM swm_helmet_device a LEFT JOIN swm_person sp ON a.assigned_person = sp.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci and sp.`status` = '0' LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive fpa ON sp.department = fpa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON sp.team = wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
a.status = '0' ${sqlMap.dsf}
AND a.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceId}, '%')
AND a.helmet_type = #{helmetType}
AND a.assigned_person LIKE CONCAT('%', #{assignedPerson}, '%')
AND a.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
group by a.id ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
SELECT device_id, corp_code FROM swm_helmet_device a where `status` = '0' AND #{random} = #{random}
